🏠 Taxation
NH HB1800 — NH Changes Education Funding: Property Tax Shift Coming

New Hampshire is moving to a new system for funding public education. This bill eliminates the existing statewide education property tax target, setting the rate at $5 per $1,000 of local real property tax assessed value. The Department of Revenue Administration will then distribute these funds to municipalities for use in their local school districts. ...
